identity.title: Deuterated Molecules in Orion KL from Herschel/HIFI

paper_type_evidence.quote: An Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array (ALMA) survey of Orion KL (214–247 GHz) collected as part of its Science Verification was used to create an image of a transition of NH$_2$D at 239.848 GHz

evidence.quote: with a pointing position of $\alpha_{\textnormal{J2000}} = 05^\textnormal{h} 35^\textnormal{m} 14^\textnormal{s}.3$, $\delta_{\textnormal{J2000}} = -05^\circ 22'33.7''$

question.value: What are the abundances and deuterium fractionation of NH2D, HDCO, CH2DOH and CH3OD in the Orion KL Hot Core and Compact Ridge, from the Herschel/HIFI fullband survey?

evidence.quote: We present a comprehensive study of the deuterated molecules detected in the fullband HIFI survey of the Orion KL region.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00009.SV.

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: ALMA Science Verification survey, 214–247 GHz; NH2D 239.848 GHz and 13CH3OH 235.881 GHz images

evidence.quote: An Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array (ALMA) survey of Orion KL (214–247 GHz) collected as part of its Science Verification

angular_resolution.value: NH2D image 1.76'' x 1.16''; 13CH3OH image 1.66'' x 0.94''; continuum 1.86'' x 1.37''

evidence.quote: The spectral resolution of the NH$_2$D image was $1.76'' \times 1.16''$, and $1.66'' \times 0.94''$ for the $^{13}$CH$_3$OH image.

provided.value: Fullband 480–1280 GHz survey of Orion KL used for all abundance derivations

evidence.quote: The HIFI survey of Orion KL used in this work covers the frequency ranges 480–1280, 1426–1535, and 1573–1906 GHz.

provided.value: J=2-1 H2CO and H2 13CO lines to break excitation degeneracy

evidence.quote: we also include in our models the three $J = 2-1$ transitions of both H$_2$CO and H$_2$$^{13}$CO measured by the Turner 2 mm (130–170 GHz) survey program

what.value: HDO/H2O ratios in Hot Core and Compact Ridge

evidence.quote: In this table the HDO/H$_2$O ratios derived for the Hot Core and Compact Ridge from (cite: neill13) are also included.

what.value: NH3 centimeter inversion line data for column density

evidence.quote: we use the centimeter inversion transitions, which have been observed going over a wide range in $J$ and $K$

archive_products_used_as_is.value: Full calibrated measurement set from the ALMA science verification site used

evidence.quote: The full calibrated measurement set is available at <https://almascience.nrao.edu/alma-data/science-verification>.
the CLEAN algorithm with robust weighting and a Briggs parameter of 0.0 was used for deconvolution

continuum_subtraction.value: continuum estimated from line-free channels near each transition

evidence.quote: the continuum emission as estimated from line-free channels near each transition was subtracted

what.value: ALMA observation details and HIFI data reduction

evidence.quote: Further details of the observation can be found in, e.g., (cite: fortman12b; neill13).

inherited.from_reference: (cite: fortman12b; neill13); Crockett et al. (2013b, in preparation)

unstated_but_needed: CASA version and imaging parameters (cell, image size, mask, niter)

analysis_steps.goal: Fit Gaussian line parameters in HIFI spectra

method.value: Multi-Gaussian fits to line profiles, with blends removed using a fullband model

evidence.quote: the contributions of different components are separated by summing multiple Gaussians to model the observed lineshapes

method.value: Optically thin upper-level column densities for NH2D with RADEX correction factor; RADEX non-LTE for H2CO/HDCO; XCLASS LTE for methanol

evidence.quote: This factor is calculated on the basis of non-LTE statistical equilibrium calculations with the RADEX code

key_parameters.value: NH2D: Tkin 200 K, n(H2) 1e8 cm-3 for correction factor

evidence.quote: A kinetic temperature of 200 K and a H$_2$ density of $10^8$ cm$^{-3}$ are used for the correction factor calculation
we assume a $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C ratio of 60 (cite: persson07), and an *ortho*:*para* ratio of 3:1

validation.value: ALMA NH2D map compared against HIFI population diagram trend

evidence.quote: the transition detected with ALMA shown in Figure 3 broadly follows the trend in a population diagram of the HIFI transitions
the CLEAN algorithm with robust weighting and a Briggs parameter of 0.0 was used for deconvolution
All data presented here were processed with HIPE (cite: ott10) version 5.0
non-LTE statistical equilibrium calculations with the RADEX code (cite: vandertak07)
we use LTE modeling in XCLASS to derive the column densities in each of these species

results_numeric.quantity: Total NH2D column density, Hot Core

evidence.quote: or a total column density of $(8.8 \pm 1.7) \times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-2}$
This yields a \[NH$_2$D\]/\[NH$_3$\] ratio of $(6.8 \pm 2.4) \times 10^{-3}$ in the Hot Core.
The \[CH$_2$DOH\]/\[CH$_3$OD\] ratio in the Compact Ridge is found to be $1.2 \pm 0.3$.

findings_qualitative.value: Hot Core generally has lower deuterium fractionation than the Compact Ridge

evidence.quote: The Hot Core generally has lower deuterium fractionation than the Compact Ridge, suggesting a slightly warmer origin

claims.hypothesis: Do water and organics have similar D/H in Orion KL?
claims.experiment: HIFI multi-transition abundances of deuterated species
claims.result: Compact Ridge D/H of (2-8)e-3 for water, formaldehyde, methanol
claims.finding: Similar fractionation, consistent with grain-mantle origin

evidence.quote: we find similar deuterium fractionation in water, formaldehyde, and methanol, with D/H ratios of (2—8) $\times$ $10^{-3}$

limitations_admitted.value: NH3 collisional rates used as proxy for NH2D; approximate

evidence.quote: This treatment is only approximate because of the significant differences in the energy level structures and allowed selection rules for NH$_2$D and NH$_3$

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA used only for qualitative maps
LTE/optically thin assumptions and source sizes drive uncertainties

evidence.quote: The full calibrated measurement set is available at <https://almascience.nrao.edu/alma-data/science-verification>.

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ALMA SV ms tens of GB; HIFI spectra small
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA minor and HIFI-based analysis depends on unpublished fullband model.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main results rely on HIFI data and unpublished models, not ALMA.

companion_papers.why: HDO and H2O abundances in Orion KL from HIFI and ALMA
